title: The Sailor & The Chef
overview: Piyush and Sushil met entirely by chance 30 years ago at a theatre in Mumbai, India. Unbeknownst to each other, they were both gay and seeking partners in a time when the internet was nascent, and there was barely any out and proud queer community. This short independent documentary narrates how they came to be a couple who created a space for themselves, as well as their discovery of dance as a way to combat aging- which has led to them winning hearts as 'Dancing Daddies'.
